en: The postcard features a black-and-white image of a three-story building with the sign 'Waldecker' in the center and a smaller sign 'Waldecker Hof' above the entrance. The building appears to be a hotel, flanked by shops with clearly visible signs reading 'Wilhelm Lindhorst' and 'Obst-Centrale.' Large trees are prominently displayed in the foreground. At the bottom, the printed text reads 'Hotel Waldecker Hof, Pyrmont.' The reverse side contains designated spaces for an address, a stamp area, and printed/handwritten notes. There is also a logo with the text 'MUSEUM' and the publisher's information: '15102 "Urania" Graphisches Institut, Berlin SW 68.'
